title: primula officinalis subsp. macrocalyx
intro: Primula officinalis subsp. macrocalyx, commonly known as Primrose or Cowslip, is a subspecies of flowering plant belonging to the Primulaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues and gastrointestinal problems. The therapeutic actions of Primula officinalis subsp. macrocalyx include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic activities, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
